claims.quote: I've been building an experimental agent that works alongside you on its own computer, helping with the messy parts of getting things done.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: If you were paying close attention, you might have noticed a few people talking about a virus spreading overseas.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: Then, on February 5th, two major AI labs released new models on the same day: GPT-5.3 Codex from OpenAI, and Opus 4.6 from Anthropic (the makers of Claude, one of the main competitors to ChatGPT).
claims.label: supported_in_text

claims.quote: I am no longer needed for the actual technical work of my job. I describe what I want built, in plain English, and it just... appears.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: The AI labs made a deliberate choice. They focused on making AI great at writing code first... because building AI requires a lot of code.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: The experience that tech workers have had over the past year, of watching AI go from "helpful tool" to "does my job better than I do", is the experience everyone else is about to have.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: The models available today are unrecognizable from what existed even six months ago.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: The most recent measurement (Claude Opus 4.5, from November) showed the AI completing tasks that take a human expert nearly five hours.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: If you haven't tried AI in the last few months, what exists today would be unrecognizable to you.
claims.label: opinion

claims.quote: If AI is smarter than most PhDs, do you really think it can't do most office jobs?
claims.label: opinion
